physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the adrenals, the small glands tucked above the kidneys that hold the body's first charge, the pressure that has you up and moving before the day has even finished asking. They run quietly. Most people only notice them when the wire is already pulled too tight.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. The hunger that dreams instead of moves is the same hunger the adrenals translate into a low hum of waiting. Years of fantasising forward, of borrowing tomorrow's feeling to survive today, leave a residue in this gland, a tiredness that sleep does not reach. The body has been priming for a beginning that never gets to begin. So the charge stays on, and stays on, and eventually starts to eat the person carrying it.

The climb out is also bodily. The pressure begins to discharge into actual first steps instead of looping back into the picture. The body learns the difference between adrenaline that is waiting and adrenaline that is going. Heat returns to the lower back. The sleep deepens. What was a tremor underneath everything becomes a clean ignition, available when needed and quiet the rest of the time. The dreamer settles into the dreamer's animal. Not less alive. Just no longer leaking.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to a single amino acid, Methionine. It is the only one of the twenty that does what it does. Every protein the body builds, every long chain of letters that becomes a piece of you, begins with Methionine. It is the start signal. The cell reads it and only then knows to begin.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the whole quiet shock of this card. The code at the floor of the dreamer is the same code at the floor of every beginning anywhere in the body, repeated trillions of times a day inside cells that will never know what they are starting. The hunger is not personal. It is the chemistry of starting itself, asking, through this one life, to be aimed somewhere true. Methionine does not finish anything. It only opens. The body has been opening this way the entire time, asking only that the rest of the person turn up and continue the sentence it has already begun.
